definition: An AI assistant embedded in a tool or workflow that helps users complete tasks with suggestions and actions.
details: Copilots differ from fully autonomous agents: they stay in the loop with a human, proposing code, drafts or next steps that the user reviews and confirms. The term became popular with GitHub Copilot, which uses a code-trained language model to autocomplete and generate code inside an editor.
story: Imagine handing a to-do list to a very clever intern who refuses to guess: before each step, they look around, check the result, and adjust. Boil it down and it is this: An AI assistant embedded in a tool or workflow that helps users complete tasks with suggestions and actions. Here is why it matters: Copilots differ from fully autonomous agents: they stay in the loop with a human, proposing code, drafts or next steps that the user reviews and confirms. The model stops being a one-shot answer machine and becomes a coworker that checks its own work. That loop of reason, act, and observe is AI Copilot.

citation.title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
